principle: Keep pane geometry live; bound only heavy Note/Library descendant reflow during fast width motion using a compositor scale proxy, then restore exact layout as soon as motion slows or ends.
sources: W3C Pointer Events Level 3: pointermove may be coalesced/delayed for performance; getCoalescedEvents exposes samples but does not remove main-thread layout cost.
web.dev Avoid large complex layouts/layout thrashing: layout cost directly affects interaction latency; ~16ms is the 60Hz frame budget example.
web.dev High-performance animations / Chrome compositor guidance: transform can resize visually without triggering layout/paint every frame.
